name: MCP Gateway Demo
description: A reference implementation of an MCP server built with Express that integrates full OAuth 2.1 authorization and RFC9728 protected resource metadata. It enables secure, authenticated communication between MCP clients and servers using streamable HTTP transport and built-in authorization flows.
